fact: A senior lecturer at Northumbria University who has researched the Nigerian police told the Research Directorate on 10 October 2020 that police records are recorded and kept manually in hard copy, though some are kept electronically at the state commands or police headquarters, and that a computer network and electronic crime database exist but are not in all police commands and the database is still at the developmental stage.
title: Nigeria: Documents issued by the police during criminal investigations or in response to a complaint (2018–October 2020)
publisher: Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada, Research Directorate
